_note: Worked plan for the DEPTH style. Hypothetical 30 s talking head (plain light wall) about comparing yourself to others: 'Jujur aja (w:0-1), kamu sering bandingin diri sama orang lain? (w:2-7) Liat temen udah sukses (w:9-12), kamu ngerasa ketinggalan (w:13-15). Padahal (w:17) yang kamu liat cuma highlight-nya (w:18-21), bukan prosesnya (w:22-23). Mereka juga jatuh bangun (w:25-28), berkali-kali (w:29). Jadi (w:31) bandingin diri kamu sama kamu kemarin (w:32-37), bukan sama orang lain (w:38-41).' Word indices are this script's own - never copy them, its words or its compositions into another video.

concept.idea: Everyone else's life is a highlight reel playing behind him; the only fair comparison is him against himself
concept.signature: A wall of 'highlight' rows (grotesk) and 'prosesnya' rows (italic serif) sliding against each other behind his head, then 'orang lain / kamu kemarin' parting on the accent colour as he pops forward

_beats: HOOK 'jujur aja' italic lead word + huge AJA behind the head, hook push
QUESTION clean face beat, one punch-in on 'orang lain'
SHOCK 'ketinggalan' echoes out behind the head in the accent colour + a light shake
MOTIF 'cuma highlight-nya, bukan prosesnya' a wall of grotesk 'HIGHLIGHT' rows and italic 'bukan prosesnya' rows sliding against each other (signature)
STRUGGLE 'jatuh bangun' close push + sweat drops doodle; 'berkali-kali' circles the head on a ring
PAYOFF 'kamu kemarin, bukan orang lain' Cutout on the accent colour, 'orang lain' (italic) and KAMU KEMARIN part behind him
